question: A shopkeeper calculates his profit per cent on the selling price and his profit is 6.25%. Find his actual profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit calculated on Selling Price (SP) = 6.25% = 1 ÷ 16

This means if the Selling Price (SP) is 16 units, the Profit is 1 unit.

Cost Price (CP) = SP − Profit = 16 − 1 = 15 units.

Actual Profit % is always calculated on the Cost Price.

Actual Profit % = (1 ÷ 15) × 100 = 20 ÷ 3 = 6(2)/(3)\% 

**∴ The correct answer is 6(2)/(3)\% **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit calculated on the Selling Price (SP) = 6.25%

**Formula Used:**

Actual Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

CP = SP − Profit

 Cost Price (CP) = 15 Profit = 1 
• 
• 
• Selling Price (SP) = 16 Actual Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 

**Calculations:**

⇒ We know the fraction value of 6.25% = 1 ÷ 16

⇒ Let the Selling Price (SP) = 16x

⇒ Profit = 1x

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = SP − Profit

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = 16x − 1x = 15x

⇒ Actual Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Actual Profit % = (1x ÷ 15x) × 100

⇒ Actual Profit % = (1 ÷ 15) × 100

⇒ Actual Profit % = 100 ÷ 15 = 20 ÷ 3

⇒ Actual Profit % = 6(2)/(3)\% 

**∴ The correct answer is 6(2)/(3)\% .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Actual Profit / Loss Percentage

Unless specifically mentioned otherwise, profit and loss percentages are universally calculated based on the Cost Price (CP). Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 and Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.

Profit / Loss Calculated on Selling Price

When profit is wrongly calculated on SP, the given percentage represents (Profit ÷ SP) × 100. Similarly, when loss is calculated on SP, it represents (Loss ÷ SP) × 100. Always convert to CP to find the true value.

Fraction Equivalents of Key Percentages

Memorizing percentage to fraction conversions saves immense calculation time: 6.25% = 1/16, 12.5% = 1/8, 16.66% = 1/6, 33.33% = 1/3, 8.33% = 1/12, and 6.66% = 1/15.
